paragraphs.text: The Sea of Serenity is the sea bordering southern Jamuura on Dominaria .

The Sea borders the Craggy Coast , the Bay of Pearls , and the Bay of Shaibara . Several islands are located in the Sea of Serenity, including the Empire of Madara , the Edemi Islands , and the Cocobar Islands . The Cocobar Islands include the island Koltos and the port Sarixa . On Koltos stands Alchor's Tomb .
Far to the south lies the southern pole of Dominaria.
